workflow.label: Workflow

draft.label: Idea drafted
draft.description: A planner wrote the brief. Nothing has been submitted yet. The item lives here until it's ready for review.
draft.next: Submit for content review when the brief is ready.

content_review.label: Awaiting content review
content_review.description: An internal reviewer is checking the brief against the brand voice and the brief's acceptance criteria.
content_review.next: Approve to move to design, or request changes to send it back to the planner.

changes_requested.label: Changes requested
changes_requested.description: A reviewer left feedback. The planner updates the brief and resubmits for another review pass.
changes_requested.next: Resubmit once the changes are in.

approved_for_design.label: Approved for design
approved_for_design.description: The brief is locked in. A designer can claim this item, or a manager can assign one.
approved_for_design.next: A designer claims the task and starts the design pass.

in_design.label: In design
in_design.description: A designer is working on the visual. Once they submit a delivery, the item moves into creative review.
in_design.next: Submit a delivery version when the design is ready.

creative_review.label: Creative review
creative_review.description: An internal reviewer (and the client for client-facing work) is checking the design against the brief.
creative_review.next: Approve to mark it ready for publishing, or request changes to send it back to design.

ready_to_publish.label: Ready to publish
ready_to_publish.description: All approvals are in. A publisher or manager can record per-channel publication outcomes once the item is live.
ready_to_publish.next: Publish on each channel, then record the outcome (published / skipped / failed) here.

partially_published.label: Partially published
partially_published.description: Some channels have gone live; the rest are still pending. Once every channel is recorded, the item moves to fully published.

published.label: Published
published.description: Every channel is live. The item is read-only for archival purposes; analytics are tracked in the dashboard.
published.next: View live performance in the workspace dashboard.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: A manager parked this item because something is preventing progress. The reason is shown next to the status.
blocked.next: Resolve the blocker, then unblock to resume the workflow.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: This item is no longer being worked on. The cancellation reason is shown next to the status.
cancelled.next: Re-create the item if it should be revived.
